purpose: Evaluate natural-query retrieval before comparing query rewriting strategies.
creation_method: Assistant-authored queries designed with awareness of the recycling domain. They were not generated from target chunk IDs or retrieval rankings, but this is not a blind or independent benchmark.
limitations: The query author has domain and source awareness.
The set is small and does not establish general performance.
Target relevance labels must be audited against source text.
Results must not be used to claim that LLM rewriting is better without a separately controlled comparison.
